correctness.rationale: Actual RESULT.md and verify.py specify 21 vertices, all 5,282 independent faces, 2,636 pairs of an acyclic augmented matching, four critical 3-faces and six 4-faces. Directed Hasse acyclicity is tested on all 25,242 cover edges, not merely inferred from greediness. Exact signed algebraic Morse projection yields the displayed 6×4 matrix B of rank 3 with a unit 3-minor (columns 2 and 3 coincide). The ordinary CW model has one vertex, 4 three-cells and 6 four-cells; π3(wedge^4 S3)=Z^4, so Smith cancellation of three unit attaching degrees leaves S3∨3S4. Direct independent re-enumeration reproduced 5,282 faces. This is a correct finite homotopy conclusion, not a general result for all n or all cycle lengths.

value.rationale: A natural 21-vertex test case of an integral torsion question has mathematical intrinsic interest, but its claimed **new** exact invariant and homotopy type are fully known and dominated by a general color-count theorem and an earlier symmetry refinement. The alternate 6×4 Morse certificate is not shown to provide a separately motivated invariant, structurally useful new lemma or improved independent conclusion. Recomputing the known case, even correctly, is insufficient new-value evidence.

final_claim: For the categorical graph product C7×K3, Ind(G) is integrally homotopy equivalent to S^3 wedge three copies of S^4 (and its reduced homology Z in degree 3 and Z^3 in degree 4).
limitations: Only the fixed C7×K3 homotopy type was assessed; alternative critical-cell counts are valid but do not establish new scientific value.
